title: Pirate City Builder Corsair Cove Launches on Steam and Game Pass Today
excerpt: German studio Limbic Entertainment and publisher Hooded Horse release their vertical pirate settlement sim across PC storefronts with day-one Game Pass access.
body:
• Corsair Cove, a pirate-themed city builder from Limbic Entertainment and Hooded Horse, launches today on Steam, Epic Games Store, and Microsoft Store with day-one PC Game Pass availability.
  • The game's signature mechanic is vertical construction — players build settlements up cliff faces and hilltops, connected by bridges, ziplines, and elevators, managing 50-plus goods across complex production chains.
  • The title surpassed 250,000 Steam wishlists ahead of launch, with early demo reception rated Very Positive on Steam.
  • Corsair Cove marks Limbic Entertainment's first independent release after the German studio's separation from Bandai Namco in late 2025.

Corsair Cove, the pirate-themed city builder from German developer Limbic Entertainment and Texas-based publisher Hooded Horse, is out today in its full 1.0 release. The game is available on Steam, the Epic Games Store, and the Microsoft Store, with PC Game Pass subscribers able to play from day one at no additional cost.

The launch caps a rapid build-up of interest since the game's reveal during the Find Your Next Game Showcase in April. By the time Hooded Horse locked in the July 31 release date in late May, wishlists had already crossed 180,000. That number climbed past 250,000 following a well-received demo at Steam Next Fest in June, where the game drew praise for its distinctive take on settlement management.

Building Up, Not Out

Where most city builders spread settlements across flat terrain, Corsair Cove forces players to think vertically. The premise drops players onto a deserted island with little more than shipwreck survivors, tasking them with constructing a pirate haven across hilltops, sea cliffs, and rock faces. Flat land is scarce by design.

https://x.com/IdleSloth84_/status/2083220042267660699

Taverns, cannon foundries, and living quarters perch on sheer rock, linked by bridges, ziplines, and precarious pathways. The logistics challenge is real: raw materials like iron, copper, lumber, and fiber must travel across chasms to reach production buildings. More than 50 goods — from hardtack and turtle soup to spyglasses, cannons, and peg-leg prosthetics — flow through supply chains that climb the rock face.

"One of the most original city-builders in a long time."

— Maurice Weber, GameStar

Crew management adds another layer. Lowly deckhands are content with stew, ale, and rum, but elite sailors — descendants of the first buccaneers — demand tobacco, pistols, and eye-patches. Neglect their needs, and they abandon the cause entirely.

Beyond the Island

Corsair Cove extends well past its shores. Players command fleets across the open sea, raid enemy settlements, hunt legendary creatures including krakens, and engage in turn-based naval combat against Crown pirate hunters. The narrative framework positions the player as the last hope for the Golden Age of Piracy, resisting a Crown that is systematically wiping pirates from the seas.

The full release ships with two game modes — a story-driven campaign and the open-ended Uncharted Mode — spread across three tropical islands with different starting conditions. A four-pronged progression tree covering Fame, Empire, Seafaring, and Wealth unlocks distinct buildings, ships, and questlines, letting players lean into trading empires or outright plunder.

The Team Behind the Cove

Limbic Entertainment, based in Langen near Frankfurt, has a track record in city management and simulation. The studio developed Tropico 6 for Kalypso Media in 2019 and Park Beyond for Bandai Namco in 2023. Corsair Cove is Limbic's first project as an independent developer following Bandai Namco's sale of the studio in late 2025.

Publisher Hooded Horse has built a reputation as a strategy-focused outfit with a developer-friendly model. Its catalog includes Manor Lords, Against the Storm, Old World, and Terra Invicta.

"It's got pirates, it's got dancing pigs, and now it's got 100k wishlists. The pigs are also your drinking buddies, so it should head even higher."

— Tim Bender, CEO, Hooded Horse

What to Watch For

The immediate question is whether Corsair Cove's vertical building concept delivers enough long-term depth. GameStar's Maurice Weber flagged this as the key variable after a four-hour hands-on with the demo. The game also launches into a crowded pirate-gaming landscape in 2026 — Windrose, the pirate survival title, surpassed 200,000 concurrent players earlier this year.

Corsair Cove is available on Steam, Epic Games Store, and the Microsoft Store, priced as a standard release. PC Game Pass members can access the full game at launch. The title is localized into 12 languages including English, German, French, Spanish, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Korean, and Japanese.
image_caption: Corsair Cove, a pirate-themed city builder from Limbic Entertainment, launched on Steam and Xbox Game Pass.
nri_angle: Available on PC Game Pass from day one, Corsair Cove offers an accessible entry point for strategy fans worldwide.
